description: Backend: extend NormalizedProduct schema with rich product data fields, update Channel3Service._normalize() to parse ALL images/offers/ratings/materials/features, enrich MOCK_PRODUCTS with full sample data, and add a GET /api/v1/products/detail/{channel3_product_id} endpoint before the existing /{session_id} route.
steps: Step 1 — Update backend/app/schemas/product.py: Add three new Pydantic models using ONLY Optional[X]/List[X] from typing (never X|Y union syntax): ProductImage(url: str, cleaned_url: Optional[str]=None, is_main_image: bool=False, shot_type: Optional[str]=None, alt_text: Optional[str]=None), ProductOffer(url: str, domain: str, price: float, compare_at_price: Optional[float]=None, currency: str, availability: str, condition: Optional[str]=None), ProductRatings(value: float, count: int, source_count: int). Then extend NormalizedProduct by adding these fields: all_images: List[ProductImage] = [], all_offers: List[ProductOffer] = [], ratings: Optional[ProductRatings] = None, materials: Optional[List[str]] = None, key_features: Optional[List[str]] = None, variants_options: Optional[List[dict]] = None, structured_attributes: Optional[dict] = None, category_title: Optional[str] = None, gender: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None. Add 'from typing import List' to the existing import (Optional is already imported). Keep all existing fields and the model_validator intact.

Step 2 — Update backend/app/services/channel3_service.py _normalize() method: After building best_offer, parse ALL images into List[ProductImage]: iterate raw.get('images',[]), for each dict extract url=img.get('cleaned_url') or img.get('url') or img.get('src'), set cleaned_url=img.get('cleaned_url'), is_main_image=bool(img.get('is_main_image',False)), shot_type=img.get('shot_type'), alt_text=img.get('alt_text'); for string entries create ProductImage(url=img). Set image_url = next((i.url for i in all_images if i.is_main_image), None) or next((i.url for i in all_images if i.shot_type=='hero'), None) or (all_images[0].url if all_images else None). Parse ALL offers into List[ProductOffer]: for each o in raw.get('offers',[]), extract url=o.get('url',''), domain=o.get('domain') or urlparse(o.get('url','')).netloc or 'unknown', price=float(o['price']['price']) if o.get('price') else 0.0, compare_at_price=o['price'].get('compare_at_price'), currency=o['price'].get('currency','USD'), availability=o.get('availability',''), condition=o.get('condition'); add 'from urllib.parse import urlparse' import. Parse ratings from raw.get('ratings'): if present and has 'value' key, create ProductRatings(value=float(r['value']), count=int(r.get('count',0)), source_count=int(r.get('source_count',0))). Parse materials from raw.get('materials'): if list of strings, use as-is; if list of dicts with 'name', extract names. Parse key_features as a clean list (already done as specs['features'] — also store as NormalizedProduct.key_features). Parse structured_attributes=raw.get('structured_attributes') or {}. Parse variants from raw.get('variants',{}).get('options'): store as variants_options. Parse category_title from raw.get('category',{}).get('title') if present. Parse gender from raw.get('gender'). Store description as a top-level field on NormalizedProduct (in addition to continuing to put it in specs). Pass all new fields to the NormalizedProduct constructor. Add 'from app.schemas.product import NormalizedProduct, ProductImage, ProductOffer, ProductRatings' (update existing import).

Step 3 — Enrich MOCK_PRODUCTS in backend/app/services/channel3_service.py: Each of the 3 mock products needs full data added. For C3-MOCK-001 (Dell XPS 15): all_images=[ProductImage(url='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1593642632559-0c6d3fc62b89?w=800&q=80', is_main_image=True, shot_type='hero'), ProductImage(url='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1593642632559-0c6d3fc62b89?w=800&q=80&crop=entropy', shot_type='lifestyle'), ProductImage(url='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1593642634524-b40b5baae6bb?w=800&q=80', shot_type='detail'), ProductImage(url='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1593642634315-48f5414c3ad9?w=800&q=80', shot_type='product_information')], all_offers=[ProductOffer(url='https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/laptops/xps-15-laptop', domain='dell.com', price=999.99, currency='USD', availability='InStock'), ProductOffer(url='https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0C1234567', domain='amazon.com', price=1049.99, compare_at_price=1199.99, currency='USD', availability='InStock')], ratings=ProductRatings(value=4.6, count=1247, source_count=3), materials=['Aluminium chassis', 'Carbon fibre palm rest', 'Gorilla Glass display'], key_features=['Thunderbolt 4', 'Wi-Fi 6E', 'Backlit keyboard'], description='The Dell XPS 15 combines a stunning OLED display...'. For C3-MOCK-002 (MacBook Pro): 4 similar Unsplash images using photo IDs from existing image_url (photo-1517336714731-489689fd1ca8), 2 offers (apple.com + amazon.com), ratings=ProductRatings(value=4.8, count=3421, source_count=4), materials, key_features, description. For C3-MOCK-003 (ThinkPad): same pattern using photo-1588872657578-7efd1f1555ed. Use realistic Unsplash URL variants by appending different crop params to the base photo ID already in each mock.

Step 4 — Add get_product_detail() alias in Channel3Service: Add a method `async def get_product_detail(self, product_id: str) -> Optional[NormalizedProduct]:` that simply calls and returns `return await self.get_product(product_id)`. This provides the semantic name the router will use.

Step 5 — Update backend/app/routers/products.py: Add a new route BEFORE the existing `@router.get('/{session_id}')` route. The new route is `@router.get('/detail/{channel3_product_id}')` (no response_model needed — return JSONResponse or plain dict). Import JSONResponse from fastapi.responses. Import NormalizedProduct, get_channel3_service. The handler: call `svc = get_channel3_service()`, then `product = await svc.get_product_detail(channel3_product_id)`. If product is None, try a DB lookup: `result = await db.execute(select(ProductResult).where(ProductResult.channel3_product_id == channel3_product_id))`, take `.scalars().first()`, return 404 NotFoundError if still None. Return `product.model_dump()` serialized — use `default=str` for datetime fields via `json_module` or convert manually: replace `retrieved_at` with `p.retrieved_at.isoformat()`. Add @limiter.limit('30/minute') and Request param. Add the db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) param. CRITICAL: This route must appear in the source file BEFORE the `/{session_id}` route so FastAPI registers it first.

Step 6 — Update the backward-compat search_products() function in channel3_service.py: In the result list comprehension, add these new keys to each dict: 'all_images': [img.model_dump() for img in p.all_images], 'all_offers': [o.model_dump() for o in p.all_offers], 'ratings': p.ratings.model_dump() if p.ratings else None, 'materials': p.materials, 'key_features': p.key_features, 'structured_attributes': p.structured_attributes, 'category_title': p.category_title, 'variants_options': p.variants_options, 'description': p.description. Also update the cache stripping logic to exclude these from session_id-keyed cache.

Step 7 — Run backend tests and fix any failures: cd /Users/testbedmac1/philldevcoder/projects/proofBuy-AI/backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q. Pay special attention to test_channel3.py::test_mock_has_unknown_specs (still needs at least one None spec value in MOCK_PRODUCTS) and test_e2e_smoke.py (the products endpoint must still return RankedProduct list with id, constraint_results, ranking_score, ranking_confidence). The existing /{session_id} route must remain fully functional.
acceptance_criteria: backend/app/schemas/product.py exports ProductImage, ProductOffer, ProductRatings classes and NormalizedProduct has all_images, all_offers, ratings, materials, key_features, variants_options, structured_attributes, category_title, gender, description fields
All three MOCK_PRODUCTS have non-empty all_images (>=4), all_offers (>=2), ratings, materials, key_features lists
GET /api/v1/products/detail/C3-MOCK-001 returns 200 with a JSON body containing channel3_product_id, name, all_images array, all_offers array, ratings object
GET /api/v1/products/{session_id} (existing endpoint) still returns the ranked product list — no regression
cd /Users/testbedmac1/philldevcoder/projects/proofBuy-AI/backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q passes with zero failures
findings: All 7 steps completed. ProductImage, ProductOffer, ProductRatings added to schemas/product.py. NormalizedProduct extended with 10 new optional fields. _normalize() updated to parse all images/offers/ratings/materials/features/variants from Channel3 API raw response. MOCK_PRODUCTS enriched with 4 images, 2 offers, ratings, materials, key_features, description each. get_product_detail() alias added to Channel3Service. GET /api/v1/products/detail/{channel3_product_id} route added BEFORE /{session_id} in products.py. search_products() backward-compat function updated to include new rich fields in returned dicts. Note for FEAT-002: JSON serialization of datetime in NormalizedProduct.model_dump() is handled manually in the detail route (retrieved_at.isoformat()); Pydantic v2 model_dump() does not auto-convert datetime to string for JSONResponse. The structured_attributes field is stored as None when empty dict from raw (to keep schema clean). MOCK_PRODUCTS retain battery_life: None in ThinkPad specs — required by test_mock_has_unknown_specs. All 77 tests pass.
